sources.title: Fire towers are fading into history (archived copy)

notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is the tnlandforms statewide list (location, elevation, codes); the name is the compiler's label for towers 73+. The record's registers (BLL US 41140, GFC US 727) look like list codes, not register numbers: see the correction. Not on NHLR's Georgia list (29 registered) or FFLOS's Georgia list (2 former sites) in the local cache. Web search results included a Cherokee County Herald Facebook post about arrests at a fire lookout tower 'near Little Ri...' (the text was not readable) and a Facebook group post about 'the old fire tower off of hwy 20 going towards cumming'; neither is tied to this site, so neither is used. A human could check whether either refers to this tower. Fort Buffington (Wikipedia, State Route 20 marker) is a separate, older site. Elevation units are inferred as feet (the list has no unit label).
